天数按“段数 × 30”估：调动/晋升的时间长短不一，必须按真实日期差算。
漏掉主职筛选：把兼岗段算进来，会把并行任职误当成“两段连续”。
questions.dialect_note: 日期差：SQL Server DATEDIFF(day, 起, 止)；SQLite julianday(止)-julianday(起)。空值兜底 SQL Server ISNULL，SQLite IFNULL。

questions.title: 多段任职之间有没有“断档”？二次雇佣的口径
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 相邻段的断档判定（LAG 取上一段 + 日期差）
questions.stem: 公司规定：任职两段之间若出现断档（后段起始日晚于前段结束日的次日），视为“二次雇佣”，要重算司龄。先核查现有数据有没有这种情况。
questions.requirement: 对有 2 段及以上任职的员工，按人把任职段按 StartDate 排序（起点相同取 ID 小者在前），对每一对相邻段计算：间隔天数 = 本段 StartDate − 前段 EndDate 的天数，并判定——前段 EndDate 为空 → “并行(前段仍有效)”；间隔天数 > 1 → “断档”；否则（间隔 = 1 或 0）→ “相接”。输出：工号、前段结束日、本段起始日、间隔天数、判定，按工号升序；每个员工只输出其第 2 段及以后的行。
questions.output_hint: 五列：工号、前段结束日、本段起始日、间隔天数、判定；按工号升序。
questions.hint: 相邻段的上一行用 LAG 按人取；间隔用日期差算。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH seq AS (
    SELECT a.EmpNo, a.StartDate, a.EndDate,
           LAG(a.StartDate) OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS prev_start,
           LAG(a.EndDate)   OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS prev_end
    FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
    WHERE a.EmpNo IN (SELECT EmpNo FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT GROUP BY EmpNo HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2))
SELECT EmpNo AS 工号, prev_end AS 前段结束日, StartDate AS 本段起始日,
       DATEDIFF(day, prev_end, StartDate) AS 间隔天数,
       CASE WHEN prev_end IS NULL THEN '并行(前段仍有效)'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(day, prev_end, StartDate) > 1 THEN '断档'
            ELSE '相接' END AS 判定
FROM seq
WHERE prev_start IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY EmpNo;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH seq AS (
  SELECT a.EmpNo AS EmpNo, a.StartDate AS StartDate, a.EndDate AS EndDate,
    LAG(a.StartDate) OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS prev_start,
    LAG(a.EndDate)   OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS prev_end
  FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
  WHERE a.EmpNo IN (SELECT EmpNo FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT GROUP BY EmpNo HAVING COUNT(*)>=2))
SELECT EmpNo AS 工号, prev_end AS 前段结束日, StartDate AS 本段起始日,
  CAST(julianday(StartDate)-julianday(prev_end) AS INT) AS 间隔天数,
  CASE WHEN prev_end IS NULL THEN '并行(前段仍有效)'
       WHEN julianday(StartDate)-julianday(prev_end) > 1 THEN '断档'
       ELSE '相接' END AS 判定
FROM seq
WHERE prev_start IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY EmpNo;
pitfalls: 把“断档”定义成“后段起始日 > 前段结束日”：相接段的后段起始日恰是前段结束日的次日（如 06-12→06-13），该写法会把全部 30 名正常调动的人误判成二次雇佣。正确口径是间隔天数 > 1。
忽略前段结束日为空：兼岗/代理段的前段主职往往还在效，间隔算不出，应单列“并行”，既不算断档也不算负数。
LAG 忘记 PARTITION BY 员工：会跨人取上一行，间隔天数变成两个人之间的差。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言均支持 LAG；日期差：SQL Server DATEDIFF(day, 前, 本)，SQLite julianday 相减。

questions.title: 司龄分档：到基准日，不满 1 年 / 1-3 年 / 3-5 年 / 5 年以上各几人
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 司龄时点计算与分档（日期差 + 左闭右开）
questions.stem: 做人才结构盘点，要按司龄段看当前在册人员的分布。
questions.requirement: 对基准日 2026-06-30 在册（HireDate ≤ 2026-06-30 且 (TermDate 为空 或 TermDate > 2026-06-30)）的员工，按其到基准日的司龄（(基准日 − 入职日)/365.25 年）分四档：不满 1 年、1-3 年（含 1 不含 3）、3-5 年（含 3 不含 5）、5 年及以上。输出：司龄档、人数，按“不满1年→1-3年→3-5年→5年及以上”的顺序排列。
questions.output_hint: 两列：司龄档、人数；按档位固定顺序。
questions.hint: 先算每人的司龄年数，再用分档表达式聚合；分档边界左闭右开。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH y AS (
    SELECT EmpNo, DATEDIFF(day, HireDate, '2026-06-30') / 365.25 AS sy
    FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
    WHERE HireDate <= '2026-06-30' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate > '2026-06-30')),
b AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN sy < 1 THEN '不满1年' WHEN sy < 3 THEN '1-3年'
                WHEN sy < 5 THEN '3-5年' ELSE '5年及以上' END AS 司龄档,
           CASE WHEN sy < 1 THEN 1 WHEN sy < 3 THEN 2 WHEN sy < 5 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS ord
    FROM y)
SELECT 司龄档, COUNT(*) AS 人数
FROM b
GROUP BY 司龄档, ord
ORDER BY ord;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT EmpNo, (julianday('2026-06-30')-julianday(HireDate))/365.25 AS sy
  FROM HR_EMPLOYEE
  WHERE HireDate<='2026-06-30' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate>'2026-06-30'))
SELECT CASE WHEN sy<1 THEN '不满1年' WHEN sy<3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN sy<5 THEN '3-5年' ELSE '5年及以上' END AS 司龄档,
  COUNT(*) AS 人数
FROM y GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE 司龄档 WHEN '不满1年' THEN 1 WHEN '1-3年' THEN 2 WHEN '3-5年' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
pitfalls: 用年份相减（YEAR(基准日)-YEAR(入职日)）：把“差 1 天满一年”的人也算成满 1 年，边界档偏多。
按中文档名排序：字符串排序会乱（“1-3年”可能排在“不满1年”之前），需显式指定档位顺序。
忘了限定“基准日在册”：把已离职的人也统计进来，总数会超过在册人数。
questions.dialect_note: 司龄：SQL Server DATEDIFF(day, 入职日, '2026-06-30')/365.25；SQLite julianday 相减再除。

questions.title: 司龄榜：当前在册里司龄最长的 10 个人
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 司龄明细榜单（排序取前 N + 并列次序）
questions.stem: 做“老员工关怀”，先把在册人员里司龄最长的一批人筛出来。
questions.requirement: 对基准日 2026-06-30 在册的员工，计算每人到基准日的司龄年数（保留 1 位小数，(基准日 − 入职日)/365.25），取司龄最长的前 10 名。输出：工号、姓名、入职日、司龄年，按司龄年降序、工号升序。
questions.output_hint: 四列：工号、姓名、入职日、司龄年；按司龄年降序、工号升序。
questions.hint: 算完司龄后排序取前 N；并列时要带工号做稳定次序。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, e.HireDate AS 入职日,
       ROUND(DATEDIFF(day, e.HireDate, '2026-06-30') / 365.25, 1) AS 司龄年
FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e
WHERE e.HireDate <= '2026-06-30' AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate > '2026-06-30')
ORDER BY ROUND(DATEDIFF(day, e.HireDate, '2026-06-30') / 365.25, 1) DESC, e.EmpNo;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, e.HireDate AS 入职日,
  ROUND((julianday('2026-06-30')-julianday(e.HireDate))/365.25, 1) AS 司龄年
FROM HR_EMPLOYEE e
WHERE e.HireDate<='2026-06-30' AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate>'2026-06-30')
ORDER BY 司龄年 DESC, e.EmpNo
LIMIT 10;
pitfalls: 先四舍五入再排序：会把真实先后打乱；应先按未取整值排序、输出时再舍入。
排序键不稳定：并列者（如两人都 7.1）取谁进 Top10 会随实现变化，题面要求并列时按工号升序固定。
把离职人员算进来：司龄榜只针对基准日在册人员。
questions.dialect_note: 取前 N：SQL Server SELECT TOP 10；SQLite LIMIT 10。司龄：DATEDIFF/julianday 相减再除 365.25。

questions.title: 配送组的人事事件流水：谁入职、谁调动、谁兼岗
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 任职事件流水（按人排序 + 事件类型派生）
questions.stem: 一个班组的“人事变动台账”，要把每个人的任职经历按时间排成流水，并标出每步是入职、调动、晋升还是兼岗/借调/离职。
questions.requirement: 取曾任职于「配送组」（组织编码 35）的全部员工，把他们的每一段任职按 起始日、ID 升序排成事件流水并标事件类型：ActionCode 为 HIRE→入职、LEAVE→离职；任职类型 AssignmentTypeCode 为 DUAL→兼岗、SECOND→借调；其余 ActionCode 为 PROMOTE→晋升、TRANSFER→调动。输出：工号、姓名、事件序（按人编号）、事件类型、组织、起始日、结束日，按工号、事件序升序。
questions.output_hint: 七列：工号、姓名、事件序、事件类型、组织、起始日、结束日；按工号、事件序升序。
questions.hint: 事件序用按人分区的行号；事件类型先用“任职类型”把 兼岗/借调 摘出来，再落到 入职/离职/晋升/调动。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS 事件序,
       CASE WHEN a.ActionCode = 'HIRE' THEN '入职'
            WHEN a.ActionCode = 'LEAVE' THEN '离职'
            WHEN a.AssignmentTypeCode = 'DUAL' THEN '兼岗'
            WHEN a.AssignmentTypeCode = 'SECOND' THEN '借调'
            WHEN a.ActionCode = 'PROMOTE' THEN '晋升'
            WHEN a.ActionCode = 'TRANSFER' THEN '调动'
            ELSE '其他' END AS 事件类型,
       o.OrgName AS 组织, a.StartDate AS 起始日, a.EndDate AS 结束日
FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
JOIN dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e ON e.EmpNo = a.EmpNo
JOIN dbo.HR_ORG AS o ON o.ID = a.OrgID
WHERE a.EmpNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT EmpNo FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT WHERE OrgID = 35)
ORDER BY e.EmpNo, 事件序;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.EmpNo ORDER BY a.StartDate, a.ID) AS 事件序,
  CASE WHEN a.ActionCode='HIRE' THEN '入职'
       WHEN a.ActionCode='LEAVE' THEN '离职'
       WHEN a.AssignmentTypeCode='DUAL' THEN '兼岗'
       WHEN a.AssignmentTypeCode='SECOND' THEN '借调'
       WHEN a.ActionCode='PROMOTE' THEN '晋升'
       WHEN a.ActionCode='TRANSFER' THEN '调动'
       ELSE '其他' END AS 事件类型,
  o.OrgName AS 组织, a.StartDate AS 起始日, a.EndDate AS 结束日
FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EmpNo=a.EmpNo
JOIN HR_ORG o ON o.ID=a.OrgID
WHERE a.EmpNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT EmpNo FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT WHERE OrgID=35)
ORDER BY e.EmpNo, 事件序;
pitfalls: 只按 ActionCode 命名事件：兼岗段的 ActionCode 往往是 TRANSFER（调动），会被错标成“调动”，漏掉“兼岗/借调”。
判断顺序颠倒：先判 ActionCode=TRANSFER 再判 DUAL，兼岗永远标不出来；要先判 兼岗/借调。
ROW_NUMBER 不加 PARTITION BY：事件序会跨人连号，不再是每人独立编号。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致（CTE + JOIN + ROW_NUMBER() OVER + CASE）。

questions.title: 离职到底以哪张表为准：任职表的 LEAVE 段 vs 花名册的离职日
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 离职口径的双源核对（任职表动作 vs 花名册离职日）
questions.stem: 做离职报表时，有人从任职表的“离职”动作取数，有人从花名册的离职日取数，两边对不上就会吵架。
questions.requirement: 分别统计：①任职表(HR_ASSIGNMENT)中 ActionCode='LEAVE' 的段数；②花名册(HR_EMPLOYEE)中 TermDate 不为空的人数；③两处“离职日”不一致的段数（任职表 LEAVE 段的 EndDate 与对应员工 TermDate 不相等，且含员工 TermDate 为空的情形）。输出：口径、数值，三行（口径名用“任职表 LEAVE 段数/花名册 TermDate 非空人数/两处离职日不一致的段数”）。
questions.output_hint: 两列：口径、数值；按 ①任职表 LEAVE 段数 ②花名册 TermDate 非空人数 ③两处离职日不一致的段数 的顺序。
questions.hint: 前两个各是一次数数；第三个要把任职表的离职段和花名册对齐后逐段比较离职日。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT 口径, 数值
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS k, '任职表 LEAVE 段数' AS 口径, COUNT(*) AS 数值
      FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT WHERE ActionCode = 'LEAVE'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, '花名册 TermDate 非空人数', COUNT(*)
      FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE TermDate IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, '两处离职日不一致的段数', COUNT(*)
      FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
      JOIN dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e ON e.EmpNo = a.EmpNo
      WHERE a.ActionCode = 'LEAVE' AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate <> a.EndDate)
) AS s
ORDER BY k;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT 口径, 数值
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS k, '任职表 LEAVE 段数' AS 口径, COUNT(*) AS 数值
      FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT WHERE ActionCode='LEAVE'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, '花名册 TermDate 非空人数', COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE TermDate IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, '两处离职日不一致的段数', COUNT(*)
      FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EmpNo=a.EmpNo
      WHERE a.ActionCode='LEAVE' AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate<>a.EndDate)
) AS s
ORDER BY k;
pitfalls: 用 COUNT(*) COUNT 花名册全表当“离职人数”：那是总人数 200，不是离职人数。
比对时忽略员工 TermDate 为空：`a.EndDate <> e.TermDate` 在员工 TermDate 为空时整行被三值逻辑过滤掉，漏掉“表间对不上”的脏数据；要显式判空。
想当然认为两表一定一致：真实系统里离职动作与花名册离职日常有出入，必须核。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

rows: 花名册 TermDate 非空人数
两处离职日不一致的段数

questions.title: 期初期末勾稽：期初 + 入职 − 离职 = 期末？
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 期初期末勾稽（期初+期间入职−期间离职=期末）
questions.stem: 出半年人力报表，最怕“三个数加起来对不上”。先用一条勾稽式把 2025 年末到 2026 年中的进出一遍。
questions.requirement: 期初=2025-12-31 在册人数；期末=2026-06-30 在册人数；期间入职=入职日落在半开区间 (2025-12-31, 2026-06-30] 的人数；期间离职=离职日落在该区间的人数。在册口径：HireDate ≤ 时点 且 (TermDate 为空 或 TermDate > 时点)。输出：期初在册、期间入职、期间离职、期末在册、勾稽结果（= 期初 + 期间入职 − 期间离职）。
questions.output_hint: 五列：期初在册、期间入职、期间离职、期末在册、勾稽结果。
questions.hint: 四个数各是一个计数，勾稽式用它们做加减。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
           WHERE HireDate <= '2025-12-31' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate > '2025-12-31')),
     b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
           WHERE HireDate <= '2026-06-30' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate > '2026-06-30')),
     h AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
           WHERE HireDate > '2025-12-31' AND HireDate <= '2026-06-30'),
     l AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
           WHERE TermDate > '2025-12-31' AND TermDate <= '2026-06-30')
SELECT a.n AS 期初在册, h.n AS 期间入职, l.n AS 期间离职, b.n AS 期末在册,
       a.n + h.n - l.n AS 勾稽结果
FROM a, b, h, l;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE HireDate<='2025-12-31' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate>'2025-12-31')),
     b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE HireDate<='2026-06-30' AND (TermDate IS NULL OR TermDate>'2026-06-30')),
     h AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE HireDate>'2025-12-31' AND HireDate<='2026-06-30'),
     l AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM HR_EMPLOYEE WHERE TermDate>'2025-12-31' AND TermDate<='2026-06-30')
SELECT a.n AS 期初在册, h.n AS 期间入职, l.n AS 期间离职, b.n AS 期末在册, a.n+h.n-l.n AS 勾稽结果
FROM a,b,h,l;
pitfalls: 期间区间取成 [期初, 期末]（两端都含）：会把期初当天入职的人重复计一次，勾稽差 1；题面用半开区间 (期初, 期末]。
期末在册与期初口径不一致（一个用 >、一个用 ≥）：端点差异会让勾稽不平。
离职取“花名册 TermDate 非空总数”：那是全历史离职，不是期间离职，勾稽必然不平。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

questions.title: 期初 vs 期末：各一级单位在册人数怎么变
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 跨时点组织对比（两时点按一级单位汇总）
questions.stem: 半年人力报告的第一张表：各一级单位年初、年中各多少人，涨了还是跌了。
questions.requirement: 按一级单位(OrgLevel=2 的组织)分别统计 2025-12-31 与 2026-06-30 两个时点的主职在册人数（按人去重）；员工的单位按其“当时有效主职任职”所在组织向上归到一级单位。任职有效口径：StartDate ≤ 时点 且 (EndDate 为空 或 EndDate ≥ 时点)，只算主职(IsPrimary=1)。输出：一级单位、期初_20251231、期末_20260630，按一级单位原始顺序排列；每个一级单位都要出现（无人的显示 0）。
questions.output_hint: 三列：一级单位、期初_20251231、期末_20260630；按一级单位升序（每个一级单位一行）。
questions.hint: 先把每个组织映射到所属一级单位，再分别按两个时点聚合人数，最后按单位对齐。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH map AS (
    SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
           CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                           WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS x WHERE x.ID = o.ParentID)
           END AS top2id
    FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS o),
s1 AS (SELECT a.EmpNo, map.top2id FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a JOIN map ON map.orgid = a.OrgID
       WHERE a.IsPrimary = 1 AND a.StartDate <= '2025-12-31'
         AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate >= '2025-12-31')),
s2 AS (SELECT a.EmpNo, map.top2id FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a JOIN map ON map.orgid = a.OrgID
       WHERE a.IsPrimary = 1 AND a.StartDate <= '2026-06-30'
         AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate >= '2026-06-30'))
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EmpNo) FROM s1 WHERE top2id = p.ID) AS 期初_20251231,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EmpNo) FROM s2 WHERE top2id = p.ID) AS 期末_20260630
FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS p
WHERE p.OrgLevel = 2
ORDER BY p.ID;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH map AS (
  SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
    CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                    WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM HR_ORG x WHERE x.ID=o.ParentID) END AS top2id
  FROM HR_ORG o),
s1 AS (SELECT a.EmpNo AS EmpNo, map.top2id AS top2id FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a JOIN map ON map.orgid=a.OrgID
  WHERE a.IsPrimary=1 AND a.StartDate<='2025-12-31' AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate>='2025-12-31')),
s2 AS (SELECT a.EmpNo AS EmpNo, map.top2id AS top2id FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a JOIN map ON map.orgid=a.OrgID
  WHERE a.IsPrimary=1 AND a.StartDate<='2026-06-30' AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate>='2026-06-30'))
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EmpNo) FROM s1 WHERE top2id=p.ID) AS 期初_20251231,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EmpNo) FROM s2 WHERE top2id=p.ID) AS 期末_20260630
FROM HR_ORG p WHERE p.OrgLevel=2 ORDER BY p.ID;
pitfalls: 只对“有人的单位”输出（用内连接）：职能中心这类时点为 0 的单位会整行缺失；题面要求每个一级单位都出现。
组织到一级单位的映射只跳一层：班组（层级 4）需向上两级才到厂/中心，只跳一层会落到部门上。
两个时点都不过滤“当时有效”：用员工当前组织代替历史组织，期初数会失真。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致（CTE + 相关子查询）。

questions.title: 全年在册人数的最高点、最低点，各自第一次出现在哪个月
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 时点序列的极值与首次出现（argmax/argmin + 次序）
questions.stem: 复盘“人数峰值”，主管会追问：最高是几月、最低是几月，是不是第一次出现就在那。
questions.requirement: 计算 2025-07 ~ 2026-06 每个月末（该月最后一天）的在册人数，在册口径：HireDate ≤ 月末 且 (TermDate 为空 或 TermDate > 月末)。输出四个数（1 行）：最高月末在册、最高首现月（达到最高值的第一个月）、最低月末在册、最低首现月（达到最低值的第一个月）。月份用 YYYY-MM。
questions.output_hint: 四列：最高月末在册、最高首现月、最低月末在册、最低首现月。
questions.hint: 先算出 12 个月末的人数序列，再分别取最大/最小值以及它们第一次出现的月份。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH n AS (SELECT 0 AS i UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 11),
m AS (SELECT DATEADD(month, i, CAST('2025-07-01' AS date)) AS mdate FROM n),
me AS (SELECT mdate, EOMONTH(mdate) AS eom FROM m),
cnt AS (SELECT mdate,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e
                WHERE e.HireDate <= me.eom AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate > me.eom)) AS n
        FROM me)
SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 n FROM cnt ORDER BY n DESC, mdate) AS 最高月末在册,
       (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(YEAR(mdate) AS varchar(4)) + '-' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(mdate) AS varchar(2)), 2)
        FROM cnt ORDER BY n DESC, mdate) AS 最高首现月,
       (SELECT TOP 1 n FROM cnt ORDER BY n ASC, mdate) AS 最低月末在册,
       (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(YEAR(mdate) AS varchar(4)) + '-' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(mdate) AS varchar(2)), 2)
        FROM cnt ORDER BY n ASC, mdate) AS 最低首现月;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH RECURSIVE m(ym) AS (
    SELECT '2025-07'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date(ym||'-01','+1 month')) FROM m WHERE ym < '2026-06'),
me AS (SELECT ym, date(ym||'-01','+1 month','-1 day') AS eom FROM m),
cnt AS (SELECT ym, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE e
                    WHERE e.HireDate<=me.eom AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate>me.eom)) AS n FROM me)
SELECT (SELECT n  FROM cnt ORDER BY n DESC, ym ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最高月末在册,
       (SELECT ym FROM cnt ORDER BY n DESC, ym ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最高首现月,
       (SELECT n  FROM cnt ORDER BY n ASC,  ym ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最低月末在册,
       (SELECT ym FROM cnt ORDER BY n ASC,  ym ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最低首现月;
pitfalls: 并列最高（如 5 月、6 月都是 174）时只按值排序取月：可能取到 2026-06；题面要“首次出现”应是 2026-05，必须加月份升序做次序键。
月末取成“下月初”或“当月末 +1 天”：跨月入职/离职会算错一个月，峰值位置漂移。
用“每月有薪酬记录的人数”代替在册：薪酬表未必覆盖全部在册人员，峰值会偏低。
questions.dialect_note: 取单值：SQL Server SELECT TOP 1 … ORDER BY；SQLite … ORDER BY … LIMIT 1。月末：SQL Server EOMONTH；SQLite date(...,'+1 month','-1 day')。

questions.title: 各一级单位的“首末任职”：最早一段、最近一段分别是哪天
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 分组取最早/最晚任职起始日（历史首末值）
questions.stem: 盘点各单位的“人脉年份”：最早什么时候有人来、最近一次来人是什么时候。
questions.requirement: 对每个一级单位(OrgLevel=2)，统计其下全部组织的任职段：最早一段任职的起始日、最近一段任职的起始日、任职段总数（不区分主职/兼岗；只统计该一级单位子树内的任职段）。输出：一级单位、最早任职起始、最近任职起始、任职段数，按一级单位原始顺序排列（只列出有任职段的单位）。
questions.output_hint: 四列：一级单位、最早任职起始、最近任职起始、任职段数；按一级单位升序。
questions.hint: 先把任职段归到一级单位，再对该单位取起点日的最小值与最大值并计数。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH map AS (
    SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
           CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                           WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS x WHERE x.ID = o.ParentID)
           END AS top2id
    FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS o)
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
       MIN(a.StartDate) AS 最早任职起始, MAX(a.StartDate) AS 最近任职起始, COUNT(*) AS 任职段数
FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
JOIN map ON map.orgid = a.OrgID
JOIN dbo.HR_ORG AS p ON p.ID = map.top2id AND p.OrgLevel = 2
GROUP BY p.OrgName, p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH map AS (
  SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
    CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                    WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM HR_ORG x WHERE x.ID=o.ParentID) END AS top2id
  FROM HR_ORG o)
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
  MIN(a.StartDate) AS 最早任职起始, MAX(a.StartDate) AS 最近任职起始, COUNT(*) AS 任职段数
FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
JOIN map ON map.orgid=a.OrgID
JOIN HR_ORG p ON p.ID=map.top2id AND p.OrgLevel=2
GROUP BY p.OrgName ORDER BY p.ID;
pitfalls: 把“最早/最近”算成员工的入职日：题面要的是“任职段起始日”，一个员工多段会有多个起点。
归一级单位时漏掉班组层：只统计部门级组织会漏掉挂在班组下的大量任职段，段数偏小。
把兼岗段排除：题面明确“不区分主职/兼岗”，都要算。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

questions.title: 主职 vs 含兼岗：一级单位的在编“段数”差几个
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 口径切换：仅主职 vs 含兼岗（按段数看差异）
questions.stem: 一份组织在编表，有人说“只算主职”，有人说“兼岗也要算”。口径不统一，同一个厂能差出好几个人次。
questions.requirement: 按一级单位(OrgLevel=2)，统计基准日 2026-06-30 在效的任职段数：①仅主职口径（只算 IsPrimary=1）；②含兼岗口径（全部在效段，含兼岗/借调）。在效口径：StartDate ≤ 2026-06-30 且 (EndDate 为空 或 EndDate ≥ 2026-06-30)。输出：一级单位、主职在编段数、含兼岗在编段数，按一级单位原始顺序排列，每个一级单位都要出现。
questions.output_hint: 三列：一级单位、主职在编段数、含兼岗在编段数；按一级单位升序。
questions.hint: 同一批在效段，用条件计数拆成“只数主职”和“全数”两列。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH map AS (
    SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
           CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                           WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS x WHERE x.ID = o.ParentID)
           END AS top2id
    FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS o),
act AS (
    SELECT a.IsPrimary, map.top2id FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a JOIN map ON map.orgid = a.OrgID
    WHERE a.StartDate <= '2026-06-30' AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate >= '2026-06-30'))
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
       SUM(CASE WHEN act.IsPrimary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 主职在编段数,
       COUNT(act.IsPrimary) AS 含兼岗在编段数
FROM (SELECT ID, OrgName FROM dbo.HR_ORG WHERE OrgLevel = 2) AS p
LEFT JOIN act ON act.top2id = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.OrgName
ORDER BY p.ID;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH map AS (
  SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
    CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                    WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM HR_ORG x WHERE x.ID=o.ParentID) END AS top2id
  FROM HR_ORG o),
act AS (
  SELECT a.IsPrimary AS IsPrimary, map.top2id AS top2id
  FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a JOIN map ON map.orgid=a.OrgID
  WHERE a.StartDate<='2026-06-30' AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate>='2026-06-30'))
SELECT p.OrgName AS 一级单位,
  SUM(CASE WHEN act.IsPrimary=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 主职在编段数,
  COUNT(act.IsPrimary) AS 含兼岗在编段数
FROM (SELECT ID,OrgName FROM HR_ORG WHERE OrgLevel=2) p
LEFT JOIN act ON act.top2id=p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.OrgName ORDER BY p.ID;
pitfalls: 两个口径都写 IsPrimary=1：两列一模一样，看不出兼岗带来的差。
含兼岗口径改按人去重：兼岗者本就在主职组织里，按人去重两口径会相等（都 174），掩盖差异；要按“任职段”计数才看得出。
只输出有差异的单位：要求每个一级单位都出现，含兼岗为 0 差异的单位也要列。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

questions.title: 逐月：主职在册人数 vs 含兼岗在岗人次
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 逐月口径切换（花名册人数 vs 任职段人次）
questions.stem: 做月度人力趋势图，主职人数和“在岗人次”两条线要不要分开展示？先把两条线的差距算出来。
questions.requirement: 对 2025-07 ~ 2026-06 每个月末，输出：①主职在册人数（HireDate ≤ 月末 且 (TermDate 为空 或 TermDate > 月末) 的花名册人数）；②含兼岗在岗人次（该月末在效的任职段数：StartDate ≤ 月末 且 (EndDate 为空 或 EndDate ≥ 月末)，不限主职）。输出：月份(YYYY-MM)、主职在册人数、含兼岗在岗人次，按月份升序。
questions.output_hint: 三列：月份（YYYY-MM）、主职在册人数、含兼岗在岗人次；按月份升序。
questions.hint: 一列从花名册数人、一列从任职表数段，逐月对齐。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH n AS (SELECT 0 AS i UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 11),
m AS (SELECT DATEADD(month, i, CAST('2025-07-01' AS date)) AS mdate FROM n),
me AS (SELECT mdate, EOMONTH(mdate) AS eom FROM m)
SELECT CAST(YEAR(me.mdate) AS varchar(4)) + '-' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(me.mdate) AS varchar(2)), 2) AS 月份,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e
        WHERE e.HireDate <= me.eom AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate > me.eom)) AS 主职在册人数,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
        WHERE a.StartDate <= me.eom AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate >= me.eom)) AS 含兼岗在岗人次
FROM me
ORDER BY me.mdate;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH RECURSIVE m(ym) AS (
    SELECT '2025-07'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date(ym||'-01','+1 month')) FROM m WHERE ym < '2026-06'),
me AS (SELECT ym, date(ym||'-01','+1 month','-1 day') AS eom FROM m)
SELECT me.ym AS 月份,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE e
     WHERE e.HireDate<=me.eom AND (e.TermDate IS NULL OR e.TermDate>me.eom)) AS 主职在册人数,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
     WHERE a.StartDate<=me.eom AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate>=me.eom)) AS 含兼岗在岗人次
FROM me ORDER BY me.ym;
pitfalls: 两列都从任职表取：第一列若也按“只数主职段”，与“花名册人数”口径不同（有人多段主职时会对不上）；题面第一列明确是花名册人数。
含兼岗口径漏掉兼岗段（只看 IsPrimary=1）：两列差距恒为 0。
月末口径不一致（一列用 ≥、一列用 >）：端点上会差人。
questions.dialect_note: 月份序列：SQL Server 递归 CTE + DATEADD；SQLite 递归 CTE + strftime。月末：EOMONTH / date(...,'-1 day')。

questions.title: 离职人员回填：离开时属于哪个一级单位
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 按离职时点回填历史组织归属
questions.stem: 离职分析要按“离职时所在一级单位”统计，不能用这个人现在的归属（他可能已离职、花名册里没有当前组织）。
questions.requirement: 对全部已离职员工（花名册 TermDate 不为空），回填其“离职时所在一级单位”：即离职日所在的那段任职的组织，向上归到 OrgLevel=2 的一级单位。输出：工号、姓名、离职日、离职时组织（末段任职所在组织名）、一级单位，按工号升序。
questions.output_hint: 五列：工号、姓名、离职日、离职时组织、一级单位；按工号升序。
questions.hint: 用“任职段结束日 = 员工离职日”找出末段任职，再把该组织归到一级单位。
questions.reference_sql:
WITH map AS (
    SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
           CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                           WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS x WHERE x.ID = o.ParentID)
           END AS top2id
    FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS o)
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, e.TermDate AS 离职日,
       o.OrgName AS 离职时组织, p.OrgName AS 一级单位
FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e
JOIN dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a ON a.EmpNo = e.EmpNo AND a.EndDate = e.TermDate
JOIN dbo.HR_ORG AS o ON o.ID = a.OrgID
JOIN map ON map.orgid = a.OrgID
JOIN dbo.HR_ORG AS p ON p.ID = map.top2id
WHERE e.TermDate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.EmpNo;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
WITH map AS (
  SELECT o.ID AS orgid,
    CASE o.OrgLevel WHEN 2 THEN o.ID WHEN 3 THEN o.ParentID
                    WHEN 4 THEN (SELECT ParentID FROM HR_ORG x WHERE x.ID=o.ParentID) END AS top2id
  FROM HR_ORG o)
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, e.TermDate AS 离职日,
  o.OrgName AS 离职时组织, p.OrgName AS 一级单位
FROM HR_EMPLOYEE e
JOIN HR_ASSIGNMENT a ON a.EmpNo=e.EmpNo AND a.EndDate=e.TermDate
JOIN HR_ORG o ON o.ID=a.OrgID
JOIN map ON map.orgid=a.OrgID
JOIN HR_ORG p ON p.ID=map.top2id
WHERE e.TermDate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.EmpNo;
pitfalls: 用员工“现在”的组织：离职人员在花名册里没有当前组织，等于无值；历史归属必须从离职日对应的那段任职取。
归一级单位时对班组只跳一层：班组要向上两级才到厂/中心。
用 StartDate 范围而不是 EndDate=TermDate 匹配：可能匹配到离职前的旧段，组织取错。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

questions.title: 二班的人员变动史：每段任职的起止与在职天数
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 某组织任职段明细（每段起止与时长）
questions.stem: 班组交接要看“这个班的人都干过多久”，包括已经调走/离职的。
questions.requirement: 取组织编码为 23 的「二班」的全部任职段，输出每段：工号、姓名、组织、主职（1/0）、起始日、结束日、在职天数（结束日为空时按基准日 2026-06-30 计）。按起始日升序。
questions.output_hint: 七列：工号、姓名、组织、主职、起始日、结束日、在职天数；按起始日升序。
questions.hint: 直接按组织过滤任职表；天数用起止日期差。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT a.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, o.OrgName AS 组织, a.IsPrimary AS 主职,
       a.StartDate AS 起始日, a.EndDate AS 结束日,
       DATEDIFF(day, a.StartDate, ISNULL(a.EndDate, '2026-06-30')) AS 在职天数
FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
JOIN dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e ON e.EmpNo = a.EmpNo
JOIN dbo.HR_ORG AS o ON o.ID = a.OrgID
WHERE a.OrgID = 23
ORDER BY a.StartDate;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT a.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, o.OrgName AS 组织, a.IsPrimary AS 主职,
  a.StartDate AS 起始日, a.EndDate AS 结束日,
  CAST(julianday(IFNULL(a.EndDate,'2026-06-30'))-julianday(a.StartDate) AS INT) AS 在职天数
FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EmpNo=a.EmpNo
JOIN HR_ORG o ON o.ID=a.OrgID
WHERE a.OrgID=23
ORDER BY a.StartDate;
pitfalls: 在职天数把空结束日当 0：未结束的人天数会算成 0 或负数；“至今在职”应按基准日兜底。
只取当前在册的人：交接历史要把已离开的人也算上，否则漏掉早期成员。
天数按“月数 × 30”估：不准确，应按真实日期差。
questions.dialect_note: 日期差：SQL Server DATEDIFF(day, 起, 止)；SQLite julianday 相减。空值兜底 ISNULL / IFNULL。

questions.title: “已经离职”却有未来离职日：这 4 个人怎么算
questions.subject: 人力
questions.knowledge_point: 离职日落在基准日之后的边界口径
questions.stem: 花名册里有些人离职日填在了基准日之后（未来）。他们到底是“在职”还是“已离职”？
questions.requirement: 找出 TermDate 晚于基准日 2026-06-30 的员工，输出：工号、姓名、离职日、距基准日天数（离职日 − 基准日）。按离职日升序。注意：这些人在基准日当天其实仍算在册。
questions.output_hint: 四列：工号、姓名、离职日、距基准日天数；按离职日升序。
questions.hint: 用离职日与基准日比较，筛出未来生效的离职记录。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT EmpNo AS 工号, EmpName AS 姓名, TermDate AS 离职日,
       DATEDIFF(day, '2026-06-30', TermDate) AS 距基准日天数
FROM dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE
WHERE TermDate > '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY TermDate;
pitfalls: 把“已填离职日”一律当已离职：这些人离职日在基准日之后，基准日当口仍在册；口径上 TermDate 非空 ≠ 基准日已走。
距基准日天数写成基准日减离职日（顺序反了）：会得到负数。
用“今天”与离职日比较：只有把基准日写死 2026-06-30，结果才可复现。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致。

questions.title: 停用/失效组织下还挂着任职记录吗
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 停用/失效组织的历史遗留记录核查（状态三值）
questions.stem: 组织被停用或过了失效日，历史任职记录不应随之删除（要留痕），但也不能再算进“在职”。先看哪些这类组织上还挂着记录。
questions.requirement: 找出「已失效或已停用」的组织：失效日(ValidTo) 早于基准日 2026-06-30，或状态(IsActive) 显式为 0（IsActive 有空值，空值不算停用）。对每个这样的组织，输出：组织名、层级(OrgLevel)、失效日、状态、该组织下的任职记录数，按组织 ID 升序。
questions.output_hint: 五列：组织、层级、失效日、状态、任职记录数；按组织 ID 升序。
questions.hint: 失效看 ValidTo，停用看 IsActive，且要区分“0”和“空值”。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT o.OrgName AS 组织, o.OrgLevel AS 层级, o.ValidTo AS 失效日, o.IsActive AS 状态,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a WHERE a.OrgID = o.ID) AS 任职记录数
FROM dbo.HR_ORG AS o
WHERE (o.ValidTo IS NOT NULL AND o.ValidTo < '2026-06-30') OR ISNULL(o.IsActive, 1) = 0
ORDER BY o.ID;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT o.OrgName AS 组织, o.OrgLevel AS 层级, o.ValidTo AS 失效日, o.IsActive AS 状态,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a WHERE a.OrgID=o.ID) AS 任职记录数
FROM HR_ORG o
WHERE (o.ValidTo IS NOT NULL AND o.ValidTo < '2026-06-30') OR IFNULL(o.IsActive,1)=0
ORDER BY o.ID;
pitfalls: 把 IsActive <> 1 当停用：会把空值也当停用；题面口径是“显式为 0”才算停用。
失效日条件用 ≤ 基准日：会把“正好基准日失效”的算进来；题面是“早于基准日”（<）。
以为停用组织的任职记录数为 0：历史遗留记录通常还在（本库「可靠性测试组」还挂着 1 条）。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致（ISNULL / IFNULL 处理空状态）。

questions.title: 研发中心花名册：补上每个人的完整组织路径
questions.subject: 组织
questions.knowledge_point: 时点归属 + 组织树路径回填（综合）
questions.stem: 研发中心人少，出花名册时想直接看到每个人“总公司 / 研发中心 / … / 班组”的完整路径。
questions.requirement: 取基准日 2026-06-30 在效的主职(IsPrimary=1)任职、且所在组织属于「研发中心」子树（组织编码 04，含工艺部、测试部及其下各班组）的员工，输出：工号、姓名、组织完整路径（自上而下用 ' / ' 连接）。按组织路径、工号升序。任职有效口径：StartDate ≤ 2026-06-30 且 (EndDate 为空 或 EndDate ≥ 2026-06-30)。
questions.output_hint: 三列：工号、姓名、组织路径；按组织路径、工号升序。
questions.hint: 组织完整路径取组织树视图；任职段按“时点在效 + 主职 + 属于研发中心子树”筛。
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, t.OrgPath AS 组织路径
FROM dbo.HR_ASSIGNMENT AS a
JOIN dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE AS e ON e.EmpNo = a.EmpNo
JOIN dbo.V_ORG_TREE AS t ON t.ID = a.OrgID
WHERE a.IsPrimary = 1 AND a.StartDate <= '2026-06-30'
  AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate >= '2026-06-30')
  AND a.OrgID IN (13, 14, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40)
ORDER BY t.OrgPath, e.EmpNo;
questions.reference_sql_sqlite:
SELECT e.EmpNo AS 工号, e.EmpName AS 姓名, t.OrgPath AS 组织路径
FROM HR_ASSIGNMENT a
JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EmpNo=a.EmpNo
JOIN V_ORG_TREE t ON t.ID=a.OrgID
WHERE a.IsPrimary=1 AND a.StartDate<='2026-06-30' AND (a.EndDate IS NULL OR a.EndDate>='2026-06-30')
  AND a.OrgID IN (13,14,36,37,38,39,40)
ORDER BY t.OrgPath, e.EmpNo;
pitfalls: 自己用组织名拼路径：会遇到“一班/二班”同名拼错层级；应取组织树视图里已算好的路径。
子树判断只匹配研发中心本级：会漏掉其下工艺部/测试部/班组的员工。
忘了时段过滤：调动过的人会在研发中心和其他单位各出一行或重复出现。
questions.dialect_note: 两方言一致；组织树视图 V_ORG_TREE 两方言均已提供。
